NotificationsEnabled.title: Enable notifications
NotificationsEnabled.description: If 'true', enables notifications for this app.

BundleIdentifier.title: App bundle identifier
BundleIdentifier.description: The bundle identifier of the app to which to apply these notification settings.

ShowInNotificationCenter.title: Show in Notification Center
ShowInNotificationCenter.description: If 'true', enables notifications in the Notification Center for this app.

ShowInLockScreen.title: Show in Lock Screen
ShowInLockScreen.description: If 'true', enables notifications on the Lock Screen for this app.

SoundsEnabled.title: Sounds enabled
SoundsEnabled.description: If 'true', enables sounds for this app.

BadgesEnabled.title: Badges enabled
BadgesEnabled.description: If 'true', enables badges for this app.

AlertType.title: Alert type
AlertType.description:
The type of alert for notifications for this app:
'0': None
'1': Temporary Banner
'2': Persistent Banner

CriticalAlertEnabled.title: Critical alert enabled
CriticalAlertEnabled.description: If 'true', enables critical alerts that can ignore Do Not Disturb and ringer settings for this app.

NotificationSettings.title: Notification settings
NotificationSettings.description: An array of notification settings dictionaries.
